english.title: Sounding unauthorised audible warning instrument on a vehicle

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[a bell]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 99(4) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
